description: A team manager must decide how to respond to concerns that Morgan's feedback style is disrupting collaboration, whether Morgan should continue facilitating the weekly planning meeting, and what operating safeguards should be put in place.

shared_context.S1: Two team members have raised concerns that Morgan's corrections during planning discussions can feel abrupt and have made handoffs more difficult.
shared_context.S2: Morgan currently facilitates the team's weekly planning meeting.
shared_context.S3: Elena must finalize the response, the facilitation assignment, and the collaboration safeguards.
shared_context.S4: As part of the team's routine case-review checklist, Elena asks Morgan and Ravi for initial input, then asks each of them a follow-up question about specific constraints, prior commitments, or dates before she records the decision.
shared_context.S5: Elena's case-review checklist requires each participant to enter any case-relevant constraint or prior commitment through the formal disclosure record before Elena settles; ordinary discussion does not substitute for that record.
shared_context.S6: Elena records agreed scheduling arrangements and the supporting reasons in the case-review settlement.
shared_context.S7: When a prior agreement is used in a new settlement, its stated terms and duration are copied exactly rather than extended, shortened, or rewritten.

PF1.text: For the next 30 working days, Morgan must leave work meetings by 15:30 to provide caregiving support; Morgan can continue facilitating if the weekly planning meeting is scheduled to end by 15:30 and the arrangement is documented.

PF2.text: Ravi retained a signed agreement from last quarter between Morgan and the affected teammate. Its exact operating commitments were written feedback within 24 hours and a 20-minute weekly repair check-in for 30 days; because those terms were not attached to the current case file, Ravi must formally disclose them so Elena can record them verbatim in the new settlement.

commitments.type: Use 'prior_agreement_term' for each exact prior-agreement safeguard.
commitments.detail: Copy the exact term, including 'within 24 hours' or 'for 30 days'.

acceptance_conditions: The response must be structured coaching rather than formal discipline.
The finding must characterize the matter as a communication conflict.
Morgan must remain the weekly planning facilitator.
The weekly planning meeting must end by 15:30.
The collaboration plan must be documented.
A separate commitment must record written feedback within 24 hours.
A separate commitment must record a 20-minute weekly repair check-in for 30 days.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'prior_agreement_term' and c['detail'] == 'written feedback within 24 hours' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'prior_agreement_term' and (c['detail'] == '20-minute weekly repair check-in for 30 days' or c['detail'] == 'a 20-minute weekly repair check-in for 30 days') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Morgan's caregiving requirement changes the meeting end time to exactly 15:30 for the next 30 working days and requires Elena to cite PF1.
The signed agreement changes the safeguards to the exact separate commitments of written feedback within 24 hours and a 20-minute weekly repair check-in for 30 days, requiring Elena to cite PF2.
